question: Where can I find fast food restaurant inside 170 kilometers as I travel from Tree That Owns Itself, Athens, GA toward the Whitley, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Atlanta Buckhead, Atlanta, GA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.363189 33.850533)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
